select distinct r.id, r.name, r.type, r.value, r.description from t_rbac_user_group ug join t_rbac_group g on g.id = ug.group_id and g.enabled = 1 join t_rbac_group_role gr on gr.group_id = g.id join t_rbac_role rl on rl.id = gr.role_id and rl.enabled = 1 join t_rbac_role_perm rp on rp.role_id = rl.id join t_rbac_perm p on p.id = rp.perm_id and p.enabled = 1 join t_rbac_perm_resource pr on pr.perm_id = p.id join t_rbac_resource r on r.id = pr.resource_id where ug.user_id = #{userId} order by r.id
